in_hebrew.name: Terah
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Terah הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Hebrew word ‘terah’, meaning ‘territory’ or ‘wanderer’. In the Bible, Terah is the name of the father of Abraham.

in_latin.name: Terah
in_latin.meaning: Latin name of biblical figure, meaning 'frequenter' or 'frequent' in English
in_latin.long_meaning: Terah, Latin name derived from Greek Τἐραχ, etymologically related to τέρω, meaning 'to traverse' or 'to cross over', historically significant in biblical genealogy, specifically father of Abraham, Genesis 11:24-25, and associated with spiritual significance of pilgrimage and journey
